evidence_type: experimental, primary (S. cerevisiae genetics and biochemistry)
claim_tested: Fmc1 acts on the Atp12 chaperone rather than on F1 directly
key_finding: fmc1 null loses F1 assembly at 37 C with alpha-F1/beta-F1 aggregation identical to atp12 and atp11 nulls; the defect is efficiently rescued by Atp12p overexpression; Fmc1p is a soluble matrix protein
organism_assay: S. cerevisiae, growth and Western blot, 28-37 C
limitations: budding yeast only; dosage suppression does not prove a direct contact

key_finding: Fmc1p-Atp12p co-purification; this is the source of the SGD GO:0005515 IPI annotation with UniProtKB:P22135
limitations: high-throughput proteome-scale study, not an fmc1-focused experiment

claim_tested: FMC1-ATPAF2 association is conserved to human
key_finding: Three independent human interaction datasets record FMC1 with ATPAF2; FMC1 also recovers NDUFAB1/mtACP, ATP5F1A, ATP5F1B, HSPA9, HSPD1, PMPCA, PMPCB
organism_assay: human cell lines, affinity purification MS
limitations: affinity-MS cannot separate direct from complex-mediated association; the F1 subunit recoveries are expected via Atp12

citation: PMID:42778582 supplementary tables (retrieved and queried, PMC13601606)
claim_tested: Does FMC1 contact Atp12/ATPAF2 or the F1 alpha subunit?
key_finding: FMC1 has exactly two predicted partners: ATPAF2 (mean ipTM 0.7816, contact probability 0.9998) and NDUFAB1/mtACP (0.6696, 0.9980), both conserved in 7 of 7 species screened. No FMC1 pair with ATP5F1A-E. The same screen scores ATPAF2-ATP5F1A at 0.7815 and ATPAF1-ATP5F1B at 0.6662
organism_assay: human mitochondrial proteome, 630,003 pairs, plus 11 eukaryotes
limitations: prediction, not experiment; the S. pombe sheet covers 413 pairs and contains no fmc1 entry, so G2TRM0 itself was not screened

citation: this work: Pfam PF13233 / InterPro IPR039196 on G2TRM0; Foldseek 3di+AA vs afdb50, afdb-swissprot, pdb100
key_finding: AlphaFold model AF-G2TRM0-F1-model_v6, 104 residues, mean pLDDT 81.0, four helices (2-23, 33-49, 55-81, 85-100). All significant Foldseek hits are fungal Complex1_LYR/FMC1 entries (best S. osmophilus E=9.9e-6, 44.1% identity). No significant PDB100 hit (best probability 0.098, E=7.4). TM-scores: FMC1 orthologs 0.39-0.45, other human LYRM proteins 0.28-0.40, ATPAF2 0.355, yeast Atp12 0.298, ATP5F1A 0.298, ATPAF1 0.239
organism_assay: S. pombe G2TRM0 model vs AFDB/PDB
limitations: TM-align-lite uses gapless threading plus iterative superposition without gapped dynamic programming, so absolute TM-scores are approximate; the ranking is the usable signal

citation: this work: PDB 5WLW contact analysis plus 38-ortholog alignment
claim_tested: Does fmc1 retain the LYRM mtACP-binding face?
key_finding: In 5WLW the ISD11 residues within 4.5 A of mtACP are R6, L10, Y13, R14, L17, R18, K21 (helix alpha-1) and R37, F40, R41 (helix alpha-2). Anchoring fmc1 Y8-R9 on ISD11 Y13-R14, the alpha-1 equivalents in fmc1 are 68.3% identical across orthologs vs 29.4% for the rest of alpha-1 (Mann-Whitney one-sided p=0.023); the alpha-2 sub-site is not conserved (12.0% vs 17.8%, p=0.86)
organism_assay: human ISD11-ACP crystal structure, S. pombe model, 38 fungal and metazoan orthologs
limitations: register transfer between distant LYRM paralogues; the alpha-1 fit is 2.26 A CA RMSD over 19 pairs, the alpha-2 register is not supported

citation: this work: conserved surface patch clustering on the AlphaFold model
claim_tested: Which fmc1 surface would contact Atp12?
key_finding: Two conserved exposed patches outside the LYR face: patch 1 on helix alpha-3 (F65, S68, H72, L75 97.4% identical, R78, H79, H80, P81) at a median 19.1 A from the mapped mtACP site, and patch 2 at the C-terminus (V98 92.1%, G99 94.7%, L100, P103 89.2%) at 37.0 A
limitations: nomination from conservation and geometry; no docked fmc1-Atp12 model was computed

citation: this work: UniProt feature review plus N-terminal charge and hydrophobic moment heuristics
claim_tested: Does fmc1 have a cleavable mitochondrial targeting sequence?
key_finding: The UniProt transit peptide on G2TRM0 and on yeast P40491 is 'Transit peptide 1-?' with ECO:0000255 and no end position. Human FMC1, LYRM4/ISD11 and NDUFA6 carry Chain 1-n with no transit peptide. fmc1 N-terminal 30 residues: net charge +5, hydrophobic moment 0.92, first acidic residue at position 17, indistinguishable from ISD11 (+5, 0.58, 19) and SDHAF1 (+5, 1.35, 17), while bounded experimental presequences exist for ATPAF2 (1-40), yeast Atp12 (1-32) and ATP5F1A (1-43, ECO:0000269). Helix alpha-1 starts at residue 2 at pLDDT 87, so removing 20-30 residues would delete the LYR motif
limitations: no experimental N-terminome or processing data for S. pombe fmc1; absence of a cleavable presequence does not exclude an internal targeting signal

evidence_type: experimental, primary (native MS and interactome MS)
claim_tested: LYRM proteins are mtACP-docking adaptor modules
key_finding: Human ACPM interacts with mitochondrial complexes through LYRM proteins, the interaction depends on the 4'-phosphopantetheine cofactor and C14-C18 3-keto-acyl chains, and ACPM is required for stability of complexes I, II, III and the Fe-S assembly complex
organism_assay: human cells, mass spectrometry and knockdown

claim_tested: Is the fmc1 pathway partner present and functional in S. pombe?
key_finding: S. pombe Atp12 localises to mitochondria and its deletion causes mitochondrial fragmentation, loss of membrane potential and shortened chronological lifespan; Atp12 also acts partly independently of ATP synthase by stabilising the mitofusin Fzo1
confidence: high for Atp12, indirect for fmc1
limitations: fmc1 itself was not assayed; shows the proposed partner has additional ATP-synthase-independent functions in this organism

claim_tested: What is the basis of the human FMC1 GO annotations?
key_finding: CLIC predicts a functional connection between C7orf55 (FMC1) and mitochondrial ATP synthase assembly; this single paper is the reference for the human FMC1 GO:0033615 IMP, GO:0005739 IDA and GO:0005515 IPI annotations
organism_assay: human and mouse microarray compendia plus follow-up experiments
limitations: a methods paper, not a dedicated FMC1 study; the experimental GO codes rest on a small validation section

claim_tested: Which protein in this pathway touches F1 directly?
key_finding: Atp11p binds selectively to the beta-subunit of F1, between Gly114 and Leu318 of the nucleotide-binding domain
limitations: concerns Atp11p, not Fmc1p; sets the comparison for what a direct F1 contact looks like

citation: this work: PSICQUIC/IntAct query of G2TRM0
claim_tested: Is there any S. pombe fmc1 interaction evidence?
key_finding: No IntAct interaction record exists for S. pombe fmc1 (G2TRM0). GO annotations for fmc1 are MF GO:0003674 ND, BP GO:0033615 IEA+IBA, CC GO:0005759 IBA and GO:0005739 IEA, with no experimental evidence code
limitations: absence of record, not absence of interaction; the PomBase API returned HTML rather than JSON for all three endpoints tried, so PomBase-specific phenotype data could not be queried programmatically
